name: singlet_annotation_cluster_label_assignment
title: Cluster-level cell type label assignment
description: Assigns one cell-type label, a score and a called or unknown flag to each cluster of an existing partition, using a tissue marker table or a reference. Defaults to scType; scCATCH, singler_cluster and scmap_cluster are comparators. Writes a per-cell broadcast label and a per-cluster table of ranked alternatives; it does not create the clustering. Do not use for per-cell labels or unclustered cells; use singlet_annotation_reference_label_transfer for cell-level transfer.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

cluster_key.description: obs column holding the cluster partition to label; each cluster receives one label.

method.description: Labelling method; scType is the default, the others are comparators for benchmarking.

tissue.description: Tissue matched against the marker table; required for scType and scCATCH with the shipped table.

marker_table.description: uns key of the marker table with type, gene, sign, tissue and species columns; null uses the method's shipped table.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

unknown_mean_score.description: Mean per-cell score below which a cluster is Unknown; scale-free form of the n/4 rule.

cell_min_pct.description: Minimum fraction of cluster cells expressing a marker.

pvalue_adjust.description: none reproduces scCATCH; bh applies Benjamini-Hochberg across genes.

reference.description: Reference handle with labelled profiles; required for this method.

quantile_use.description: Quantile used to aggregate reference correlations for each cluster.

fine_tune_thres.description: Score gap for keeping labels in the fine-tuning round.

aggregation.description: sum_counts reproduces legacy SingleR cluster mode; mean_normalised is the singlet default.

reference.description: Reference handle with an scmap cluster index; required for this method.

threshold.description: Similarity below which a cluster is unassigned.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/cluster_label. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_clusters, n_called, n_unknown, median_margin. Completed runs only; never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
